megan: quick check on role-map prototype v4. two items: collapsed rows on narrow screens and SSO toggle location in the invite modal (inline vs settings banner). proto: https://img.redwood/proto/rolemap-v4.png :eyes: ryan: compact rows look cleaner but could hide details. add chevron + tooltip 'show role details'? megan: yes. tooltip + aria-expanded. mobile chevron expands inline panel not flyout. kai: note: add analytics event for expansion (expanded_view boolean). perf: prefer CSS height toggles to avoid re-renders on long lists. olivia: a11y: tooltip needs keyboard target and label. collapsed rows should expose SR-only permission summary like 'Role Admin: deploy, manage models'. ryan: microcopy for SSO confirm: change to clearer phrasing. propose: label 'Require Single Sign-On (SSO)' helper 'When enabled, new and existing members must authenticate via your SSO provider.' Confirm heading 'Enable SSO for this organization' body 'This will enforce SSO for all members and may change how users sign in. Manage providers in Settings > Security.' Primary 'Enable SSO' Secondary 'Cancel — review settings' megan: placement debate: inline (below email) surfaces at invite time; banner makes org-level effect clearer. kai: inline toggle will write settings. surface warning 'Enabling SSO will disable password sign-in for new users.' olivia: accessibility: auth changes require focused confirmation dialog and simple language. avoid terms like 'tenant' or 'provisioning'. kai: implementation snippet idea for aria states:
…permissions…
olivia: prefer toggling aria-hidden to update SRs during animation; ensure focusable elements are reachable when expanded. deploy-bot: preview: https://preview.redwood/rolemap-v4 (build: rolemap-v4-2026-03-22) :rocket: megan: next steps: ryan update copy & tooltip; kai add analytics event and aria changes; olivia write SR-only summaries and test with VoiceOver; i'll open PR for invite modal update. ryan: will post updated frames EOD PST. kai: will add server flag and perf note in PR. olivia: will test SR behavior. megan: thanks!
